topic: Claude Code with a free local LLM: the Ollama setup
title: Claude Code on a Free Local LLM (Ollama)
description: Ollama now speaks the Anthropic Messages API, so Claude Code can run against a free local model on your own hardware. You set three environment variables, dodge the 4k default context trap, and run your first local prompt tonight. You'll learn what ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL actually changes and where local models still fall over. (Narration is AI-generated.)
hook_text: CLAUDE CODE RUNS WITHOUT ANTHROPIC'S CLOUD
hook_candidates: Twenty dollars a month, or three lines tonight.
Claude Code runs without Anthropic's cloud.
Your terminal agent doesn't need Anthropic's servers.
Three lines turn Claude Code local tonight.
Four thousand tokens will break your local Claude Code.
Claude Code on your GPU, zero dollars a prompt.
You pay Pro rates. Your GPU idles.
Ollama speaks Anthropic's language since January.
Sixteen gigabytes runs a Claude Code model tonight.
Same agent, same terminal, zero dollars a prompt.
narration_full: Claude Code runs without Anthropic's cloud. In January, Ollama began answering the Anthropic Messages API, Claude Code's request format. Your twenty-dollar Pro agent now runs on your gaming PC. Claude Code is a courier packing Anthropic-format boxes. The base address, where requests go, is only the drop-off. Ollama, your garage, signed by copying Anthropic's protocol, so box quality rides on shelf space, your card's memory. The catch: it's Ollama's engineering, not Anthropic's blessing. The previous open model scored six point six percent on tool use. Ollama's default context, how much code it sees, starts at four thousand tokens. Agent work wants sixty-four thousand tokens minimum, so set that first. Tonight, run ollama launch claude with qwen three coder, then check slash status. Same terminal, same agent, zero dollars a prompt.

analogy.vehicle: A courier route with a changeable drop-off address
analogy.mapping: Claude Code is the courier that always packs the same Anthropic-format boxes; ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is only the delivery address, and Ollama is your garage that learned to sign for them.
analogy.limit: The receiver had to implement the sender's exact protocol to sign at all, and once delivery is free the box quality depends on your garage's shelf space (VRAM), not the courier.
